_format.description: Material properties for simulation. Every number carries the source it was taken from; values without a traceable source are left out rather than guessed.
_format.anisotropic: permittivity as [x, y, z] in the material frame; for uniaxial crystals [perp, perp, parallel] with the c-axis along z

4K.unavailable: At GHz frequencies and cryogenic temperature copper is in the anomalous skin-effect regime, so RRR * sigma(293 K) overestimates Q with Palace's classical Conductivity boundary. Pass an effective conductivity fitted to a measured Q, e.g. get_material('copper', '4K', conductivity=...).
